params.name: steps
params.interactions: lightx2v: distilled = '12-25x speed improvement with no significant loss in performance in most cases'; InstantX note: 'The official number of steps is 50 but I think that's too much. Even just 10 steps seems to work.'

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: true CFG; at 1.0 ComfyUI skips the negative pass

official_reference_code.2.1: 1 ('cfg 2 follows dense prompts more closely... cfg 5 degrades quality badly, and cfg 0.5 breaks the image')

params.interactions: cfg must be 1 under Lightning (defeats the distillation otherwise); 'Set cfg to 1.0 for a speed boost at the cost of consistency' (InstantX note)

params.name: shift
params.meaning: flow timestep shift (ComfyUI QwenImage config default 1.15; node default 1.73)

defaults.2.1: none (config 0.69 internal; no node in the template)

params.interactions: 'Increase the shift if you get too many blurry/dark/bad images. Decrease if you want to try increasing detail.' Community (single source): shift 12-13 'solves most issues with bad outputs' with the 8-step LoRA - a last-resort knob that conflicts with the templates

params.name: sampler_name / scheduler
params.interactions: 'Samplers like res_multistep work pretty well at cfg 1.0' (InstantX note); 2.1: 'More advanced samplers need fewer steps'

params.name: width / height
params.interactions: edit outputs follow the (scaled) input: ImageScaleToTotalPixels 1-1.5 MP or FluxKontextImageScale; inpaint max dimension 1536; 2.1 prefers multiples of 32 and 1 MP default / 4 MP native 2K

params.name: strength
params.meaning: post-CFG x0-space rescale ('attenuate-only') used by every Edit template

params.name: megapixels / largest_size
params.meaning: input normalisation before edit/control ('to avoid poor output results caused by excessively large input image sizes')

defaults.edit: 1.5 MP lanczos (template widget; docs say ~1 MP)

params.name: resolution
params.meaning: 2.1 reference pixel budget: 'Reference images are resized to about resolution x resolution pixels, at multiples of 32, preserving aspect ratio. 0 keeps each reference at its own size, rounded to a multiple of 32.'

params.name: layers
params.meaning: number of RGBA layers to decompose into

rules.message: every Qwen-Image family model (incl. Edit, 2512, Layered, 2.1) encodes text through CLIPLoader type 'qwen_image'
Qwen-Image / Edit / 2509 / 2511 / 2512 / Layered use the Qwen2.5-VL-7B encoder (qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled in every template); ComfyUI detects it at qwen25_7b.transformer.
Qwen-Image-2.1 uses the Qwen3-VL-8B encoder (qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot / bf16 / w4a8), detected at qwen3vl_8b.transformer. - not the 2.5-VL file
Qwen-Image / Edit / 2509 / 2511 / 2512 decode with qwen_image_vae.safetensors (16-ch Wan2.1-style latent)
Qwen-Image-2.1 has its own RGBA VAE (64-channel, /16 latent); the 16-ch qwen_image_vae cannot decode it
Qwen-Image-Layered decodes RGBA layers with qwen_image_layered_vae.safetensors
every Qwen-Image / Edit / 2512 template sets ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3-3.1 (lightx2v distilled at shift 3); the node default 1.73 and the config's 1.15 are not template values
above 3.1 you are outside every template; the note allows raising shift against blurry/dark output, and one community report uses 12-13 with the 8-step LoRA - treat as a last resort
Qwen-Image-Layered runs at shift 1.0 (both layered templates), not the 3-3.1 of the other Qwen models
under a Lightning / Turbo LoRA cfg is 1.0 (every template's switch sets 1); cfg > 1 defeats the distillation and doubles the cost
a 4-step Lightning LoRA is sampled at 4 steps (template switch value)
an 8-step Lightning LoRA is sampled at 8 steps
the Wuli 2-step Turbo LoRA is sampled at 2 steps

qwen_image_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors 'was produced by directly downcasting the original bf16 weights'; the bf16-trained Qwen-Image-Lightning LoRAs produce 'a grid-like pattern' on it. On the plain fp8 base use Qwen-Image-fp8-e4m3fn-Lightning-4steps-V1.0 (distilled on fp8), or switch to the bf16 / lightx2v scaled-fp8 base
Edit-2509 / 2511 condition on the input image(s) through TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus (Picture 1..3 + reference_latents); plain CLIPTextEncode gives the model no image
the original Qwen-Image-Edit conditions through TextEncodeQwenImageEdit (image + vae for the reference latent)
every official Qwen-Image-Edit template (Edit, 2509, 2511, relight) inserts CFGNorm strength 1 after ModelSamplingAuraFlow
the Edit templates start from VAEEncode(input image) as latent_image (full denoise; it fixes the output size to the scaled input) - an empty latent breaks the size/alignment
the Qwen latent nodes take width/height in multiples of 16; control recipes that size from GetImageSize need a control image already at a multiple of 16

not in Qwen-Image's native aspect table (1:1 1328x1328, 16:9 1664x928, 9:16 928x1664, 4:3 1472x1104, 3:4 1104x1472, 3:2 1584x1056, 2:3 1056x1584; the older README's 4:3/3:4 were 1472x1140 / 1140x1472) - it runs, but the model was trained at these (not applied with the 360 LoRA, which is trained at 2:1 2048x1024 - see 360-size-2048x1024)
InstantX recommends conditioning scale 0.8-1.0; templates use 1.0
the Qwen ControlNets (InstantX union/inpainting, Fun 2512) are applied with the VAE connected (ControlNetApplyAdvanced.vae / ControlNetInpaintingAliMamaApply.vae) in every template
the DiffSynth union control LoRA takes its control map as a ReferenceLatent on the conditioning (VAEEncode of the map on both positive and negative); without it the LoRA has no control signal
the alibaba-pai Fun ControlNet-Union 2602 is trained for Qwen-Image-2512 (template pairs it with qwen_image_2512_fp8_e4m3fn)
Layered samples into EmptyQwenImageLayeredLatentImage (layers x H x W) and decodes after LatentCut(t, 1) -> LatentCutToBatch(t, 1); EmptySD3LatentImage is the wrong shape

the recipe's template needs at least this ComfyUI: the 2.1 templates need 0.37.0 / 0.37.2 (> pinned 0.35.0: TextEncodeQwenImage21, QwenImage21Cache); InstantX inpainting >= 0.3.59; everything else <= 0.8.0
the multiple-angles LoRA needs its trigger: '<sks> [azimuth] [elevation] [distance]' (card: '<sks> trigger is essential', 'Respect the order')
the 360 LoRA: 'For best results use the 2:1 resolution of 2048x1024' (other sizes struggle with the horizon); an equirectangular image is 2:1
the 360 LoRA on an fp8_e4m3fn/e5m2 transformer 'may cause patch or grid artifacts' - use bf16 (the template), int8 or GGUF Q8
the 360 LoRA activates on its trigger words ('equirectangular', '360 image', '360 panorama')

prompting.negative_note: A single space is the official negative for Qwen-Image / Edit / 2509 / 2511 ('using an empty string if you do not have specific concept to remove'); Comfy templates ship "" or " " interchangeably. Ignored whenever cfg is 1 (every Lightning branch, all of 2.1).

negative_alternatives.qwen-image-2512 (official, verbatim): 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲。
negative_alternatives.comfy 2512 templates: 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲 (no trailing full stop)

positive.line: Append the official 'magic' suffix ', Ultra HD, 4K, cinematic composition.' (English) / ', 超清，4K，电影级构图.' (Chinese) to T2I prompts

Text rendering: put the exact strings in double quotes inside a scene description - 'A coffee shop entrance features a chalkboard sign reading "Qwen Coffee 😊 $2 per cup," with a neon light beside it displaying "通义千问".' Scripts: English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese

Edit instructions are imperative sentences: 'Change the rabbit's color to purple, with a flash light background.'; 2509 two-image: 'The magician bear is on the left, the alchemist bear is on the right, facing each other in the central park square.'; 2511: 'Change the furniture leather difference in image 1 to the fur material in image 2.' - refer to inputs as image 1 / image 2 / image 3

2.1 addresses references by tag: 'Keep the character and pose in <image1> unchanged, put this light blue denim shirt from <image2> on the character, preserve the original facial features, hair, body shape and pose'; paint a coloured mark on image_1 and name the colour to target a region ('change the jacket in the red area')
2.1 RGBA output: 'This is an RGBA image with transparency. A cute cartoon dragon sticker. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.' - save PNG

InstantX ControlNets: 'it is highly suggested to add TEXT into prompt if there are text elements' ('a poster with text InstantX Team on the top'); InstantX inpainting: describe the ENTIRE image descriptively, not instructively
Layered: the prompt describes the whole input including occluded content; it does not control individual layers
Relight LoRA (2509): prepend its trigger '重新照明,' (the template does it with StringConcatenate)

prompting.structure: T2I: full scene description with quoted text strings + the magic suffix. Edit: one imperative instruction naming image 1/2/3. 2.1: <imageN> tags.
